macros.name: AddToList
macros.doc: \AddToList{⟨list⟩}element adds an element to a list.

macros.name: NoSort
macros.doc: performs no sorting, meaning that elements are listed in reverse order of addition.

macros.name: ReverseSort
macros.doc: performs ⟨test⟩ on the list elements and gives the reverse result.

macros.name: ShowList
macros.doc: The \ShowList{⟨list⟩}{⟨callback⟩} macro executes ⟨callback⟩ on every item of the list, in order.

macros.name: SortAlpha
macros.doc: sorts elements alphabetically, after they have been stripped of nonalphabetical characters.

macros.name: SortLen
macros.doc: sorts elements by their length, counted by number of tokens.

macros.name: SortNum
macros.doc: sorts elements numerically; all elements must be numbers.

macros.name: StripForAlpha
macros.doc: \StripForAlpha{⟨text⟩}{⟨callback⟩} is a helpful function to precede alphabetical sorting. It takes ⟨text⟩, uppercases it, and removes all non-alphabetical characters from it.
